_doc: Ground-truth labels for the v2 screen classifier proving bench. Each clip lists per-frame expected states at 1 fps. Boundaries [t_start_sec, t_end_sec] are INCLUSIVE on both ends (1fps sampling means t=N corresponds to source video second N). See README.md for the operator labeling workflow. RE-ANCHORED 2026-06-01: spans were re-aligned to the canonical-PTS sampler (iter_sampled_frames) after commit c872670 flipped Pass-1 off the old ffmpeg-fps _iter_raw_bgr_frames sampler the original labels were authored against. Only boundary seconds moved; every span was re-verified by eye against the dumped canonical-PTS frames.

clips.name: match-250-lobby-loadout
clips.description: Match 250 first 60s: matchmaking screen → pre_game_lobby_state_2 → player_loadout_view drill-in → back to lobby → WORLD OF CHEL splash → post-game leaderboard. Auto-converted from match-250-clip-segments.json (hand-labeled 2026-05-13), remapped to v2 state vocabulary in S5.5 prep, re-anchored to the canonical-PTS sampler 2026-06-01.

clips.name: match-968-menu-sequence
clips.description: Match 968 first 60s: the original failure case. The session navigates CLUB management → PLAYER LOADOUTS hub → loadout detail → back to lobby → WORLD OF CHEL splash → SEASON 4 leaderboard recap → OPENING CLASH cutscene. v1 mis-classified the CLUB/loadout/WoC spans as pre_game_lobby_state_2, contaminating the typed lobby extractor. v2 must classify these correctly OR fall back to unknown_or_transition for the two deferred classes (menu_club_management, player_loadout_landing). Re-anchored to the canonical-PTS sampler 2026-06-01.

PLAYER LOADOUTS hub: blank card with X-FACTORS/ATTRIBUTES placeholders + X-FACTOR GLOSSARY footer hint. Deferred — relaxed. Re-anchored from [10-13]: t=14 is still the blank hub; the detail view starts at t=15.

Clean WORLD OF CHEL splash. Stylized title at mid-frame; OCR typically can't read it. Re-anchored from [46-47] to the single frame t=47 under the canonical-PTS sampler.
Season 4 ELITE CUP CHAMPIONS leaderboard recap — same OOD screen as match-250's leaderboard. Tightened by the leaderboard_cup reject prior in S5.5.
Pre-game arena → 'OPENING CLASH' cutscene (in-rink shot then team banners, BM vs mtl) — closest legitimate state for a loading-style intro.

clips.name: match-2582-postgame
clips.description: WS6 post-game arm (match 2582, BM 3-2 RR, OT). The ORIGINAL WS6 failure: every post-game screen decoded as unknown_or_transition because the v1->v2 migration dropped the post-game text anchors (docs/ocr/ws6-postgame-classifier-diagnosis.md). Source window 1882-1982s. Labels cover the four DATA-bearing screens with stable multi-second dwell — action_tracker (period-filter cycling), faceoff_map, net_chart, events (scoring summary) — plus the END OF GAME team-stats tab (no dedicated state -> unknown). Box-score tabs appear only as sub-second blips at 1fps here (min-dwell), so they are validated per-frame by diagnose_postgame_classification.py, not end-to-end on this clip. Dropdown/category transition frames (header occluded) are left UNCOVERED. Labeled against the canonical-PTS sampler (iter_sampled_frames) per F7.

labels.notes: Game->post fade (t0-4) then the END OF GAME team-aggregate tab (BM 3-2 RR + team stats). That tab has no dedicated state and correctly stays unknown; the 'playersummary' token in the nav tab-bar must NOT pull it to post_game_player_summary (the classifier holds on visual).
ACTION TRACKER, 1st-period filter (header 'ALL EVENTS ... 1ST PERIOD'). Rink event-marker map + event list.
ACTION TRACKER, 2nd-period filter.
ACTION TRACKER, 3rd-period then OT filter.
FACEOFF event map (header 'FACEOFF ... PERIOD'); faceoff-percentage side strip + rink dot map.
NET CHART event map (header 'NET CHART ... PERIOD').
Back on the END OF GAME team-stats tab (no state) before the box-score category.
SCORING SUMMARY 'ALL' filter (goals + penalties list by period). Header 'ALL' (bare) -> post_game_events; the bare 'all' prior must not be eaten by action_tracker's 'all events'.
